title: Change of tides in European chemical legislation a turning point in European chemicals policy: reconciling green ambitions with the viability of the manufacturing sector in Europe
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00746A, Perspective
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Éva Ujaczki, Jan Backmann
The EU's strict post-2006 REACH chemical control is debated: a point of pride or a barrier to competitiveness due to overregulation. The European Commission supports the latter. This paper informs researchers on the political process and its impact. Image generated using Google Gemini.
